page.overview:
What is Stands?

A is a visual manifestation of life energy (in other words, the manifestation of the soul of the user).

A Stand is an entity psychically generated by its owner, referred to as a . It generally presents itself as a figure hovering over or near the user and possesses abilities beyond those of an ordinary human, which, depending on the Stand User, can be wielded for good or evil.

A Stand User is limited to a single full Stand at once. There has been a single case of a "sub-Stand" shown to exist. Due the Stand User's dissociative identity disorder, their second identity wielded a separate "sub-Stand". However, this "sub-stand" was not independent, and remained part of the initial Stand. It remains unclear whether dissociative identity disorder would always create a "sub-Stand" effect within a Stand User who suffered from the condition though.

Stands are defined as personifications of "life energy" (although it's later changed to "spiritual energy") whose abilities are given visual form. When first presented, the term is written as |Sutando}}, with to change the pronunciation of what literally means in .

Also known as: Stand, スタンド.
